_comment: One device's git server: how it listens and who may sign up. The Gitea page edits this per device; repositories and accounts are managed in Gitea's own UI. A gitea_secrets.json appears beside this file when the state is first composed: machine-generated and safe to lose, since a fresh one only invalidates sessions and tokens.
_comment_root_url: Base URL written into clone addresses and links. Empty derives http://<device address>:<port>/.
